# Ashraf Selo

> Senior Motion Graphics Designer, AI Creative and Video Editor based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. 8+ years creating motion graphics, 3D motion, social media reels, AI-generated films and story-first video edits for brands, agencies and government entities across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and the MENA region. Works in Arabic and English.

## Services
- Motion Graphics Design (logo animation, kinetic typography, brand motion systems, explainers): https://ashrafselo.com/services/motion-graphics-designer/
- Video Editing and Post-Production (commercials, event recaps, corporate films, color and sound): https://ashrafselo.com/services/video-editing/
- Reels and Social Media Video (vertical video, paid social ads, platform-native content): https://ashrafselo.com/services/social-media-reels/
- 3D Motion Graphics and CGI (product visuals, event-screen animation, look development in Blender): https://ashrafselo.com/services/3d-motion-graphics/
- AI Video Production (AI filmmaking, AI ads, prompt-directed generative content): https://ashrafselo.com/services/ai-video-production/

## Locations served
Dubai (based), Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, all UAE emirates; remote work across the MENA region.
